watches.name: Argo | Silver Gloss - Royal Blue
watches.description: All good products start with the design, and our focus for the Limited Edition Argo collection was on style, features and comfort. The Limited Edition Argo is classic design with a contemporary twist and features a sunray dial as well as diamond cut 3D hands, with Swiss Super Lumi Nova ® luminosity. A high-grade Stainless Steel case, Premium Sapphire Crystal, with antiglare coating to both sides of the glass, and a Swiss Ronda Quartz movement are just some of the additional features we’ve packed into the Argo. The case and straps were designed with comfort in mind. Lug width, case back and Strap materials all contribute to the perfect fit on your wrist, and we've added quick change spring bars to all of our straps so they can be changed or swapped over without the need for any tools.

specsRaw.Model: Argo Silver Gloss / Royal Blue
specsRaw.Strap: Stainless Steel Mesh Bracelet with quick change spring bar – no tools required. Adjustable length (strap only) 130mm - 185mm end to end closed.

watches.name: Ocean Explorer | Silver / White
watches.description: Our passion for watch design, travel and adventure were the inspiration for our new collection of fully automatic dive watches. The Ocean Explorer has refined looks and impressive functionality and is the perfect companion for exploration above and below the water. Available in a choice of 5 colours, featuring our unique 'Ocean Waves' dial design, the fully automatic Explorer is built from stainless steel and has a depth rating of 200 metres (660 feet). Swiss Superluminova luminosity ensures visibility even in the darkest underwater environments, and the sapphire crystal glass, with 3 layers of anti reflective coating, provides a crystal clear view of the hands, index and time elapsed bezel. We've also included a day/date feature for added functionality. Other features include a screw down crown and an exhibition window on the case back giving a perfect view of the automatic movement in action. The Ocean Explorer is a stunning high quality timepiece that has style in abundance and comprehensive functionality. Once you have one you wont want to be without it.

watches.name: Chronograph One | Silver / Lapis Blue - Black Rubber Strap
watches.description: Housed in a Stainless Steel case, combining brushed and polished parts, Chronograph One is both an analogue display watch and a sophisticated timing device. The Chronograph stopwatch measures in minutes and seconds and also includes a split time function. Scratch resistant Sapphire Crystal glass with anti-glare coating, diamond cut luminous hands and the elegant sophistication of a Sunray dial also feature. Additionally, we’ve added a date window at 4.30 to complete this great all round timepiece. Our rubber straps are made with high grade FKM rubber, which is very flexible, extremely tough and super comfortable to wear. FKM Rubber is a high density material, yet soft to touch, which makes it a great choice for a watch strap. The buckle, like the watch, is stainless steel. 'Chronograph One' is powered by a Seiko Japanese quartz movement for both accuracy and reliability.

watches.description: Glamorous everyday elegance is in abundance with the Stellar range. A refined contemporary look that’s perfect with a party dress or easy weekend meet-ups! The all stainless steel case, which features a combination of brushed and polished parts, houses a sleek Sunray dial with distinctive glistening stud hour markers. The defined contemporary look continues with hands for hours, minutes and seconds, and also includes a date window at 3 o’clock, all framed underneath Sapphire Crystal glass. The Stellar range includes both stainless steel link and leather straps, and is powered by a Japanese Miyota quartz movement, which ensures near perfect timekeeping.
